brief: Hi team! Copper Kettle Bistro is reopening our heated patio on 2026-12-04 and we want people to know. Can you make four Instagram posts, one 30-second reel of the patio at night, and a short Google Business Profile update? We have our logo and last year's patio photos but they're from summer so probably not great. Owner wants to approve everything before it goes out. Also not sure what our budget is yet, still waiting on that.

plan.summary: Produce four Instagram posts and one reel for the Copper Kettle Bistro patio reopening on December 4, 2026, using existing assets with new winter photography. All content requires owner approval before publication.
